records.jp: うん、いいよ
records.en: Yeah, sure.

records.jp: 付き合ってほしいことって、これー？
records.en_original: This is what you wanted me to help with?
records.en_auxiliary: This is what you wanted me to help with?
records.en: This is what you wanted my help with?

records.jp: 嘘は言ってない
records.en: I didn't lie.

records.jp: でも先に言ってくれればいいじゃん
records.en_original: Not exactly... But you could've told me first!
records.en_auxiliary: Not exactly... But you could've told me first!
records.en: But you could've told me that first.

records.jp: 言ったら逃げるでしょ
records.en_original: Would you have come if I had?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you have come if I had?
records.en: If I had, you would've run away, right?

records.jp: まぁ、そうだけど。<CR>だって全然わかんないし
records.en_original: I guess not... But that's just 'cause I don't understand this stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess not... But that's just 'cause I don't understand this stuff.
records.en: Well, yeah.<CR>I don't understand any of it.

records.jp: どこがわからないの？
records.en_original: Which parts do you not understand?
records.en_auxiliary: Which parts do you not understand?
records.en: What don't you understand?

records.jp: 全部
records.en: All of it.

records.jp: そんなんで今までどうやってきたわけ……？
records.en_original: How did you possibly make it this far like this...?
records.en_auxiliary: How did you possibly make it this far like this...?
records.en: How have you managed until now...?

records.jp: んー、要領と運？
records.en: Hmm, intuition and luck?

records.jp: むかつく
records.en: You're infuriating.

records.jp: いやいや、それほどでも
records.en: No, no, it's not that impressive.

records.jp: 褒めてない
records.en: I wasn't praising you.

records.jp: 基礎から教えるから、全部覚えて
records.en_original: I'll teach you everything starting with the basics.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll teach you everything starting with the basics.
records.en: I'll teach you from the basics, so learn all of it.

records.jp: えー
records.en: Ehh...

records.jp: えーじゃない
records.en_original: Don't give me any of that.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't give me any of that.
records.en: No "ehh."

records.jp: （なんだかんだ言って）
records.en: (For all my complaining...)

records.jp: （伶那さんはカッコいい人だと、私は思ってる）
records.en: (I think Rena-san is a cool person.)

records.jp: （みんながなあなあにする部分。<CR>楽しければいいやと、後回しにすること）
records.en_original: (The rest of us are only ever worried about having fun.)
records.en_auxiliary: (The rest of us are only ever worried about having fun.)
records.en: (The things everyone glosses over.<CR>The things we put off because as long as it's fun, that's good enough.)

records.jp: （そういったところを全部見抜いて、<CR>伶那さんは指摘する）
records.en_original: (But Rena makes sure we're always on the right path.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But Rena makes sure we're always on the right path.)
records.en: (Rena-san sees right through all of that<CR>and points it out.)

records.jp: （伶那さんがいなかったら、この世界での私たちの<CR>生活はうまく回っていなかったかもしれない）
records.en_original: (I don't think we would have gotten very far here without someone like her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't think we would have gotten very far here without someone like her.)
records.en: (If Rena-san weren't here, our lives<CR>in this world might not be going nearly so smoothly.)

records.jp: （たぶん嫌われるのが怖くない人なんだろう）
records.en_original: (She's not scared of other people not liking her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's not scared of other people not liking her.)
records.en: (Maybe she's someone who isn't afraid of being disliked.)

records.jp: （私にはできない）
records.en: (I couldn't do that.)

records.jp: よっしゃ、全問解けた！！
records.en: All right, I got every question!!

records.jp: はい、じゃ次はこの応用問題ね
records.en: Okay, then next is this applied problem.

records.jp: もうよくない？
records.en: Isn't this enough already?

records.jp: 覚えてるうちに慣らさないと、定着しないから
records.en_original: If you don't use it while it's fresh, it won't stick.
records.en_auxiliary: If you don't use it while it's fresh, it won't stick.
records.en: If you don't get used to it while you still remember it, it won't stick.

records.jp: うげぇ
records.en: Ugh...

records.jp: （優しいよな。ここまで面倒見てくれるなんて）
records.en_original: (Rena sure is nice to stick with me this whole time.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Rena sure is nice to stick with me this whole time.)
records.en: (She's so kind, looking after me this much.)

records.jp: （嚙み砕いて説明してくれるし、教科書に<CR>載ってないこと聞いてもパッと答えてくれるし）
records.en_original: (She breaks everything down into easy-to-understand chunks, and answers all my stupid questions.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She breaks everything down into easy-to-understand chunks, and answers all my stupid questions.)
records.en: (She explains things in a way I can understand, and if I ask about something<CR>that isn't in the textbook, she answers right away.)

records.jp: 手、止まってる
records.en: Your hand's stopped.

records.jp: はいはい、やりまーす
records.en: Yeah, yeah, I'm doing it.

records.jp: （だから、私は伶那さんのことをカッコいいと思う）
records.en: (That's why I think Rena-san is cool.)

records.jp: （どうして伶那さんは、伶那さんでいられるの<CR>だろう？）
records.en: (How does Rena-san manage<CR>to stay Rena-san?)

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>三色弁当<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Tri-colored Lunch<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Tri-colored Lunch<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Tri-colored Lunch<CLNR> memory.
